# Subway Seat for Sublime Text

A color scheme for Sublime Text 4 with gutter diff marks, bracket and find highlights, and hover popups in the same grounds. To follow the system appearance, set `"color_scheme": "auto"` with `dark_color_scheme` and `light_color_scheme`.

[Sublime Text](https://www.sublimetext.com) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/sublime-text/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat.sublime-color-scheme`](Subway%20Seat.sublime-color-scheme) | `Packages/User/Subway Seat.sublime-color-scheme` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`Subway Seat Tunnel.sublime-color-scheme`](Subway%20Seat%20Tunnel.sublime-color-scheme) | `Packages/User/Subway Seat Tunnel.sublime-color-scheme` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`Subway Seat Enamel.sublime-color-scheme`](Subway%20Seat%20Enamel.sublime-color-scheme) | `Packages/User/Subway Seat Enamel.sublime-color-scheme` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Preferences → Settings, after copying the file to Packages/User (Preferences → Browse Packages…):

```json
"color_scheme": "Subway Seat.sublime-color-scheme"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Preferences → Settings, after copying the file to Packages/User (Preferences → Browse Packages…):

```json
"color_scheme": "Subway Seat Tunnel.sublime-color-scheme"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Preferences → Settings, after copying the file to Packages/User (Preferences → Browse Packages…):

```json
"color_scheme": "Subway Seat Enamel.sublime-color-scheme"
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `Packages/User/Subway Seat.sublime-color-scheme`.
- Delete `Packages/User/Subway Seat Tunnel.sublime-color-scheme`.
- Delete `Packages/User/Subway Seat Enamel.sublime-color-scheme`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
